name: Taro Root
siboNotes: Well-tolerated starchy vegetable that can provide energy without feeding problematic bacteria. Cook thoroughly to improve digestibility.
preparationTips: Always cook thoroughly - never eat raw as it contains calcium oxalate crystals
Boil, steam, or roast until tender and starchy texture develops
Peel completely before cooking to remove irritating compounds
Can be mashed, cubed, or sliced after cooking
